title: Secure Document Link for mobile client and participant access
purpose: Define the minimum control boundary for mobile upload and read links that connect authenticated users to matter-bound document storage without storing secret links or raw mandate content in the product repository.

properties.evidence_id: Stable evidence identifier without secret material.
properties.purpose: Specific action purpose such as upload_document or read_current_matter.
properties.expires_at: UTC timestamp after which the issued link must no longer be accepted.
properties.matter_binding: Tenant, case and optional document binding for the issued link.
properties.storage_target: One of sharepoint_document_library, sharepoint_list_item_attachment or onedrive.
properties.revocation: Revocation handle, status and reason metadata.
properties.audit_event: Append-only audit event reference for issuance, use, expiry or revocation.
properties.content_hash: Hash of uploaded content when content exists and can be hashed.
properties.file_type_check: Result of file type, malware and size checks.
properties.issued_by_role: NaC role that issued or approved the link.
properties.identity_assurance: Authentication source and assurance metadata without raw eID or certificate material.
